title: Sanp type back covers and bezel for watch cases - Dimensions
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the dimensions of conunon types of back cover and bezel for watch cases.
clause_3_terminology: Sanp type back covers and bezel for watch cases

dimensional_tolerances: Tolerance ± 100 and tolerance in micrometre ( f4m
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
